sections.A: Movement ke saath nerves ko phisalna aur lamba hona parta hai. Sensitive nerve (jaise sciatica ke baad) khinchne par symptoms deti hai.
sections.B: Ahem tests: SLR, slump aur upper limb neurodynamic tests. Structural differentiation se pata chalta hai ke symptoms nerve se hain.
sections.C: Slider nerve ko ek siray se lamba aur doosre se chhota karta hai (halka); tensioner dono siron se khinchta hai (zyada zor). Sensitive nerve mein pehle sliders.
sections.D: Sawaal hal karein. Test positive tab hai jab wahi symptoms aayein aur door ki movement se badlein.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
